info.name: Finance Backend API Copy
info.description:
Complete collection covering Auth, Financial Records, Dashboard, and User Management.

**Quick start:**
1. Run `POST /api/auth/login` with seeded credentials.
2. Copy the returned `token` value.
3. In Collection â†’ Edit â†’ Variables, paste it into the `adminToken` current value.
4. All other requests will automatically send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

item.description:
All requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}}`.
Mutations (POST, PUT, DELETE) require ADMIN role.
GET endpoints are accessible by every authenticated role.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: All authenticated roles (VIEWER, ANALYST, ADMIN) can access all dashboard endpoints.

response.name: 200 OK — UserResponse (multi-role user now holds this role too)
409 Conflict — user already has this role
400 Bad Request — cannot revoke last role
response.body: { "error": "Bad Request", "message": "Cannot revoke the last role from a user", "statusCode": 400 }

response.name: 404 User does not hold this role
response.body: { "error": "Not Found", "message": "User does not hold this role", "statusCode": 404 }

response.name: 200 OK — deduplicated union of all role permissions (Composite pattern)

item.name: Permission Management

response.name: 400 Invalid name format
response.body: { "error": "Bad Request", "message": "Permission name must match format resource:action", "statusCode": 400 }

response.name: 409 Conflict — permission assigned to a role
response.body: { "error": "Conflict", "message": "Permission is assigned to one or more roles", "statusCode": 409 }

item.description: CRUD for permissions (ADMIN only). Permissions follow the format resource:action (e.g. records:read).

item.name: Role Management

response.name: 200 OK — list of RoleResponse with permissions
200 OK — updated RoleResponse (now includes the permission)
409 Conflict — role assigned to users
response.body: { "error": "Conflict", "message": "Role is assigned to one or more users", "statusCode": 409 }

item.description: CRUD for roles and their permission assignments (ADMIN only).
